SFRPG.WeaponPropertiesHarryingTooltip: Burst is a hail of ammunition aimed at a single target. The attacker receives a +2 bonus to his skill check. A Critical Failure result when using a weapon in burst mode indicates that the weapon has jammed. A successful Engineering DC25 check is needed to unjam a weapon. Burst uses 3 rounds of ammunition.
SFRPG.WeaponPropertiesExtinguishTooltip: Fire is a single attack aimed at a single target. It involves the use of one control die and one situation die, as with all normal actions.
SFRPG.WeaponPropertiesAutomaticTooltip: Autofire is a burst from an automatic weapon that is walked across its target instead of aimed. Up to three different targets within 6 meters of each other can be affected by autofire (the first target must be within 6 meters of the third target, with the second target falling somewhere between them). An autofire attack expends three bursts of ammunition from a weapon's clip. Autofire uses 9 rounds of ammunition.

EnableOverlay.Name: Enable Alternity Overlay
EnableOverlay.Hint: Activates Alternity-style skill point, achievement, and class overlays.

AutoAddUnarmedStrike.Name: Auto Add Unarmed Attack
AutoAddUnarmedStrike.Hint: When enabled, sf-alternity adds the Unarmed Attack weapon to new characters and disables SFRPG's UUID-based unarmed auto-add setting.

AbilityConversion.Name: Ability Score Conversion
AbilityConversion.Hint: For NPC's only, Characters use Alternity conversion Item (Feat) If enabled, converts core ability scores from their Alternity values to the closest SFRPG equivalent when calculating derived values for actors. For example, an Intelligence score of 12 would be treated as 14 for the purposes of calculating skill points and FX power, while a score of 8 would be treated as 6.

SkillRankLimitOffset.Name: Skill Rank Limit Offset
SkillRankLimitOffset.Hint: Adjusts the maximum allowed skill ranks for characters. Final cap is actor level plus this offset (for example, +2 allows level + 2).

HideCoreCompendiums.Name: Hide Core SFRPG Compendiums
HideCoreCompendiums.Hint: Removes Starfinder system compendiums from the Compendium directory in this world.

StartingSkillPointsBase.Name: Base Starting Skill Points
StartingSkillPointsBase.Hint: Flat number of starting Alternity skill points granted before Intelligence is applied.

IntelligenceMultiplier.Name: Intelligence Skill Point Multiplier
IntelligenceMultiplier.Hint: Multiplier applied to the actor's Intelligence score when determining starting Alternity skill points.

LevelSkillPointBase.Name: Per-Level Skill Point Base
LevelSkillPointBase.Hint: Base number of Alternity skill points granted at each level above 1.

LevelSkillPointIncrement.Name: Per-Level Skill Point Increment
LevelSkillPointIncrement.Hint: Additional scaling applied per level above 1 when calculating earned Alternity skill points.

SpecialtySkillRule2C.Name: Optional Rule 2C: Flat Specialty Rank Cost
SpecialtySkillRule2C.Hint: When enabled, purchasing rank 2 or higher in a specialty (non-class) skill uses list price only; existing ranks do not increase the advancement cost.

ShortRestResolveFx.Name: Spend Resolve To Restore FX Power
ShortRestResolveFx.Hint: If enabled, a 10-minute rest spends 1 Resolve Point to restore FX power. Recovery only applies when enough Resolve remains after the core short rest is processed.

ShortRestResolvePsionics.Name: Spend Resolve To Restore Psionic Power
ShortRestResolvePsionics.Hint: If enabled, a 10-minute rest spends 1 Resolve Point to restore psionic power. Recovery only applies when enough Resolve remains after the core short rest is processed.

ShortRestFxRecoveryFormula.Name: FX Power Rest Recovery Formula
ShortRestFxRecoveryFormula.Hint: Number or roll formula for FX power restored by a 10-minute rest. Supports @ references from actor roll data.

ShortRestPsionicRecoveryFormula.Name: Psionic Power Rest Recovery Formula
ShortRestPsionicRecoveryFormula.Hint: Number or roll formula for psionic power restored by a 10-minute rest. Supports @ references from actor roll data.

StarshipDamageThresholds.Name: Starship Damage Thresholds
StarshipDamageThresholds.Hint: Modify what % of the starship's hull points must be lost before it takes critical damage. SFRPG default is 20%.

Spells.FXBonusPrompt: Enter the manual FX power bonus.
Spells.PsionicBonusPrompt: Enter the manual psionic power bonus.
Spells.PowerCastInfo: Casting consumes power equal to the selected spell level.
Spells.WarningInsufficientPower: Current {poolLabel} is too low to cast any available spell level.
Spells.UntypedHidden: {count} untyped spell items are hidden from Alternity tabs.
Spells.InvalidHidden: {count} spell items are flagged as both FX and Psionic and are hidden.
Spells.EmptyFX: No FX spells are assigned to this character.
Spells.EmptyPsionics: No psionic spells are assigned to this character.

FXFactor.Label: FX Power Factor
FXFactor.Hint: Multiplies Intelligence when calculating the actor's FX power pool.

PsionicFactor.Label: Psionic Power Factor
PsionicFactor.Hint: Multiplies Will when calculating the actor's psionic power pool. Each Mindwalker starts with psionic energy points equal to his or her Will score. A talent or a Diplomat with the Mindwalker secondary profession has psionic energy points equal to one-half his or her Will score (rounded up). Psionic Energy Points: Talent .5×Will, Diplomat(Mindwalker) .5x Will, Mindwalker 1×Will, Fraal 1.5×Will

FXCost.Label: FX Talent Skill Point Cost
FXCost.Hint: Default base skill point cost for FX spell talents on actors using this archetype.

PsionicCost.Label: Psionic Talent Skill Point Cost
PsionicCost.Hint: Default base skill point cost for psionic talents on actors using this archetype.

MaxSkillPointsAdjustment.Label: Skill Point Adjustment
MaxSkillPointsAdjustment.Hint: Adds or removes available Alternity skill points for characters of this species.

MaxSkillPointsAdjustmentClass.Label: Skill Point Adjustment
MaxSkillPointsAdjustmentClass.Hint: Adds or removes available Alternity skill points for characters of this class.

RandomAbilityFormulas.Hint: Formulas used when rolling this species' random abilities (for example: 2d8+2).

ShortRecoveryPrompt.Title: Alternity Short Rest Recovery
ShortRecoveryPrompt.Description: Choose which Alternity pools {actorName} should restore by spending Resolve Points after this short rest.
ShortRecoveryPrompt.ResolveBudget: You can spend up to {resolvePoints} Resolve Point(s) on this additional recovery.
ShortRecoveryPrompt.ResolveWarning: You do not have enough Resolve Points for that selection.
